findings.title: REQ-020 R06 ("a lint violation fails CI and is named") does not hold for the ruleset's own centerpiece addition: react-hooks/exhaustive-deps (and react-hooks/incompatible-library, react-hooks/unsupported-syntax) ship as severity "warn" in eslint-plugin-react-hooks's flat recommended config, and `npm run lint` has no `--max-warnings 0`.
findings.evidence: ts/eslint.config.js (whole config) + ts/package.json:7 (`"lint": "eslint ."`). Verified via `node -e "require('eslint-plugin-react-hooks').configs.flat.recommended.rules"` → `exhaustive-deps: "warn"`. Proof: removed the 5 pre-existing `eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` comments in Popover.tsx, TerminalRegion.tsx (x2), HtmlViewerRegion.tsx (x2); `npm run lint` reported "5 problems (0 errors, 5 warnings)" and exited 0. Change reverted; git status clean.
findings.consequence: A real exhaustive-deps violation would be named but would NOT fail CI, contradicting the acceptance line as written. The self-check used an error-severity rule (@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars, exit 1), which doesn't cover the gap because the one new rule family this phase exists to enforce is warn-severity.
findings.condition: REQ-020 R06 holds: a lint violation fails CI and is named; a clean tree passes.

findings.title: Five pre-existing `eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` comments remain, line-suppressing exactly the rule the owner ruling forbids trimming; only one of six such pre-existing disables was removed/fixed in this branch.
findings.evidence: ts/src/stage/Popover.tsx:109, ts/src/stage/TerminalRegion.tsx:307 and :463, ts/src/stage/HtmlViewerRegion.tsx:242 and :260 (all pre-existing on dev). Scope: "fix every violation the ruleset flags in the existing tree in this phase... Do not trim a rule so that today's tree passes"; the new eslint.config.js repeats "Do not disable or trim a rule to make the tree pass; fix the code instead."
findings.consequence: Since these are warn-level anyway this doesn't change CI's green/red outcome today, but it is a direct, checkable violation of the phase's own stated rule and undermines the "29 found and fixed" baseline claim — the found/fixed count did not include these.
findings.condition: Lint baseline (owner ruling, 2026-09-30): fix every violation the ruleset flags in the existing tree in this phase, recording how many were found and fixed. Do not trim a rule so that today's tree passes.
